People: Carlo Bini (author, Wikidata Q3659082), died 1842; Giuseppe Mazzini (notes, Wikidata Q187336), died 1872. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bini, Carlo, 1806-1842; Mazzini, Giuseppe, 1805-1872 [Commentator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Scritti : editi e postumi / di Carlo Bini ; reintegrati sui manoscritti originali e notevolmente accresciuti per cura di G. Levantini-Pieroni, Firenze : Successori Le Monnier, 1869, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/scrittieditiepo00biniuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 65%, 82%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
